references.text: Joshua gave Hebron to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his inheritance, just as the Lord had promised him because of his faithfulness.
Caleb son of Jephunneh received a portion among the people of Judah: Kiriath-Arba, that is, Hebron. From there he drove out the three sons of Anak.
The Lord promised Caleb the land he had walked through because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Moses repeated the promise that Caleb son of Jephunneh would receive the land on which he had set his foot.
A parallel passage in Chronicles describes how the Levites received cities with pasturelands, while Caleb received the fields and villages around Hebron.
